summary: Cuba Hill lookout in Cass County, listed standing and inside the Chippewa National Forest; no dated build, height or staffing record found in reachable sources.

evidence.supports: Wikidata classes it as a fire lookout tower
elevation of about 1,434 feet above sea level
located in the Chippewa National Forest
listed as a standing tower in Cass County

notes_for_editor: Only location, county, forest, Wikidata elevation (about 1,434 ft) and standing status are supported by reachable pages. The Wikidata elevation of 1,434 ft matches the brief's 437.1 m. A search summary said a minnesotafiretower.blogspot.com post (Cuba Hill Lookout Tower, December 2012) gives a pre-1935 build and a 120-foot ladder tower, and that another blog page says two or three towers survive in the Chippewa National Forest. Those claims are unverified: the blog post, the December 2012 archive and the August 2012 Chippewa history page all returned 404 here, so they are not used and no height or build year is recorded. The Forest Lookouts index gives no build or height data. An OpenStreetMap node (8169190028, Cuba Hill Lookout, tower:type observation) was read but not cited. The Wikidata image Cuba Hill Lookout Tower.jpg (2,736 x 3,648) was not read, so no photo is added. No staffing, notable fires, access or condition was found; the brief's access 'unknown' stands.
